name: The Shops at Blackstone Valley
summary: The Shops at Blackstone Valley is an outdoor lifestyle center featuring national retailers, diverse dining options from Mexican to Asian cuisine, and a cinema complex. Located on the Worcester-Providence Turnpike, this popular destination serves the greater Worcester and Providence areas with a convenient mix of shopping and entertainment.
demographics: The Shops at Blackstone Valley attracts a diverse middle to upper-middle class demographic from the Worcester and Providence metro areas, with primary visitors aged 25-54 representing families and young professionals. The trade area serves suburban communities in central Massachusetts and northern Rhode Island with median household incomes ranging from $65,000 to $95,000. Shoppers typically include dual-income households seeking convenient access to national retailers, dining, and entertainment options in an outdoor setting. The center draws both weekday convenience shoppers and weekend leisure visitors who appreciate the mix of retail, restaurants, and cinema offerings.
description: The Shops at Blackstone Valley is a premier outdoor lifestyle shopping destination strategically located on the Worcester-Providence Turnpike in Millbury, Massachusetts, serving the greater Worcester and Providence metropolitan areas. This open-air shopping plaza features a carefully curated mix of household name retailers, diverse dining outlets ranging from Mexican to Asian cuisine, and a modern cinema complex that makes it a complete entertainment destination. The center's outdoor design creates an inviting atmosphere where shoppers can enjoy a pedestrian-friendly experience while accessing their favorite national brands and restaurants. With its convenient location along a major transportation corridor, The Shops at Blackstone Valley has become a regional draw for both everyday shopping needs and leisure activities. The center's strong tenant mix and entertainment offerings have earned it a 4.4-star rating from over 5,300 reviews, reflecting its popularity as a go-to destination for Central Massachusetts and Northern Rhode Island residents seeking quality retail, dining, and entertainment all in one location.
